title: plugin-approvals: approval notifications name the record by its id — "Your Contract C8Mp7TjRYta8mOWx was approved."
body:
Filing class: ② needs a maintainer re-ruling — it revisits ruling B of #23556 / #23594 (`{{object}} {{record}}` = object label + record id). Reach: public door, measured on 18.1.0 with objectstack-ai/hotclm `main` (`pnpm demo:zh`). **Reader:** the maintainer, then the approvals lane (`plugin-approvals/src/translations/messages.ts`, `approval-notification-text.ts`).

## 维护者速读
审批通知现在用记录 id 指代记录：「Approval requested — A decision on Contract C8Mp7TjRYta8mOWx is waiting on you.」「Your Contract C8Mp7TjRYta8mOWx was approved.」。收件人看不出是哪份合同，要点进去才知道。这是平台之前的裁决（#23556/#23594 方案 B）定下的写法，要改需要重新裁决。

## Measured
All 11 notifications of one hotclm regression pass, read back from `sys_notification`: the four `approval.requested`, two `approval.approved` and one `approval.rejected` name the record as `Contract <16-char id>`. The app's own notifications in the same bell name it by title ("Contract approved: 回归测试 订单 25万（审批阶梯）").

## Options
- **A** — name the record by its display title (the object's title field, ADR-0079), id only when the title is empty or unreadable to the recipient.
- **B** — title plus id ("Contract 回归测试 订单 25万 (C8Mp…)").
- **C** — keep the id (current ruling).

Dedupe: objectstack issues (2,000 most recently updated, all states) grepped for `{{record}}`, `record by its id`, `23594` — neighbours #24375 / #24501 (object API name on the request page), none revisits this.

---
_Filed from the hotclm browser regression thread (2026-10-26); maintainer: 「平台的问题应该提交issue到平台」._
